newsitem.title: EGYPT: Alexandria Portland Cement H1 profit up.
newsitem.headline: Alexandria Portland Cement H1 profit up.

text.p: Alexandria Portland Cement said on Monday that profit available for distribution rose to 30 million pounds in the first half of the financial year 1996/97 from 29.5 million in the same period of the previous year.
The financial year start on July 1.

The profit works out at three pounds for each of the 10 million shares. The Capital Market Authority in October approved Alexandria Portland Cement's 10-for-one share split, which was aimed at stimulating share turnover.
In 1995/96, the company's distributable profit rose to 56 million pounds from 53.20 million in the previous year.
Turnover in the six-month period from July to December 1996 rose to 102.40 million pounds from 97.89 million in the same period the previous year.
The company's shares closed at 70 pounds on the Egyptian stock exchange on Sunday, before the results were announced.

The state's Holding Company for Chemical Industries continues to hold 79.4 percent of the shares, while the remaining 20.6 percent are owned by private investors, employees and an Employee Shareholders Association.
